metadata.workspace: Native numeric temporary allocations; excludes inputs, output, library code, stacks, and opaque CPU BLAS/TBB allocations. CUDA includes its explicit 4 MiB BLAS workspace. Process peak is reported separately.
metadata.reference: CPU float64 production prefix-suffix on the same rounded inputs and cotangents; separate small-case checks use independent Chen autograd.
metadata.timing: Nine alternating synchronized samples. Reconstruction and native allocation/free are timed. CUDA baseline retains its production cache; prototypes allocate/free their numeric workspace on each call.
